statusVocabulary.REGENERATED: the producer ran on the candidate and its output is retained
statusVocabulary.BYTES-MATCH: two or more independent regenerations, and the committed artifact where one exists, are byte-identical
statusVocabulary.VERDICTS-AGREE: two or more regenerations agree on every pass/fail verdict and count; bytes not compared or differing (timestamps, durations)
statusVocabulary.SINGLE-RUN: exactly one successful regeneration exists; no agreement shown
statusVocabulary.PASS-ONLY: only a job or test conclusion exists; no output to compare
statusVocabulary.VALIDATED: the source is the artifact (inventory); its validator ran on the candidate and passed
statusVocabulary.RE-MATERIALIZED-VERIFIED: pinned input fetched again and verified against its pins; never rebuilt
statusVocabulary.REGENERATED-FAILING: regenerated on the candidate; the producer reports failure
statusVocabulary.BLOCKED: a required producer, input, or gate failed, or the output cannot serve its consumer; needs a decision
statusVocabulary.NOT-REGENERATED-BY-RULE: the inventory or contract forbids or excludes regeneration
statusVocabulary.STALE-CLASSIFICATION: the frozen inventory still classifies the artifact stale; any output here is a candidate output only
statusVocabulary.IMPORTED-HASH-VERIFIED: a record produced before the candidate, committed here unchanged; its hashes equal the C1 manifest's; it establishes nothing for the candidate
